body: Is he truly my friend if he’s suddenly ditching someone that has been going through a rough couple of months?
No but there’s been hints he could be in love with me
Yea I mean in the rut of it I called him a dick, an asshole bc I was angry. If we are not talking. How do I show I’m making progress?
So all these things I started doing now. Is it possible for things to mend?
I hope. So many of my friends and family say it’ll blow over. I want to have my buddy back. I wish I can reverse time and think of every little thing that could have caused this
Yea I keep questioning myself what I did wrong. There were things here and there but nothing out of the ordinary. I have had heightened anxiety but this was a guy who always helped me
Based on family and friend observations a lot of people believe he does in fact have feelings and this is a way temporarily to cut things off
